text: Jayco describes Gerry Ryan as its founder and owner.
short: Jayco is founded and owned by Gerry Ryan.

source.name: Jayco Australia: Jayco Founder Gerry Ryan Recognised in 2026 Australia Day Honours
source.quote: At Jayco, we are incredibly proud to share that our founder and owner, Mr Gerry Ryan AO OAM, has been appointed as an Officer of the Order of Australia (AO)
